title: Spec 014 Wave 1 readback lifecycle separation and retirement

phases.objective: Retire the completed single-use Wave 1 evidence collector while retaining read-only pull-request validation, the permanent owner-bound R7 runtime readback contract, and fail-closed governance for bounded post-integration maintenance.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository governance reviewer validating Spec 014 evidence lifecycle boundaries
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A change to the storage control-plane guard, permanent R7 readback surface, lifecycle contract, or post-integration maintenance gate
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The retained contracts prove that pull-request validation remains read-only, the completed one-time collector is absent, future public runtime verification is available only through the bounded owner-bound R7 workflow, and a maintenance branch can target main only when one changed implemented single-PR contract covers every changed runtime file after all affected parallel workstreams are integrated.
steps: Load the retained storage control-plane guard and permanent R7 workflow through executable contract coverage.
Require the storage control-plane pull-request guard to retain contents: read and its control-plane validation job.
Require the R7 workflow to remain owner-bound, public-HTTPS-GET-only, exact-SHA-bound, and conversation-read-only.

Allow bounded post-integration maintenance only when the target is main, every affected multi-PR contract is implemented with all required workstreams integrated, and one changed implemented single-PR contract covers every changed runtime file.

Independently derive and revalidate the unique changed single-PR maintenance contract inside phase evaluation, and suppress only stale unchanged-contract findings for implemented multi-PR contracts whose required workstreams remain integrated.

Reject under-scoped maintenance contracts, non-main targets, reopened parallel delivery, pull-request write permissions, repository content mutation, protected-ref mutation, provider credentials, deployment actions, SQL, Migration Apply, database mutation, or secret inclusion.
Preserve the retained R7 artifact identity and keep issue 6215 open as the runtime control record until deployment parity is separately authorized and proven.
assertions: The completed single-use evidence collector is not restored.
The permanent R7 readback remains exact-command, owner-bound, bounded, scrubbed, and public-GET-only.
Post-integration maintenance fails closed unless one changed implemented single-PR contract covers every changed runtime file and every affected multi-PR workstream remains integrated.

Phase evaluation independently revalidates the unique changed maintenance contract and removes no finding unless runtime coverage, main targeting, implemented status, secret exclusion, and integrated parallel work all hold.
Post-integration maintenance is rejected when it targets a branch other than main or when parallel delivery is reopened.
The retained surfaces perform no repository, runtime, database, provider, deployment, credential, or external business mutation.
Regression coverage fails if write authority, the removed one-time collector, or an unbounded maintenance bypass returns.

phases.objective: Keep the retained R7 evidence path, storage control-plane pull-request guard, and bounded post-integration maintenance classification aligned as future repository changes occur.

Prove lifecycle separation across R7 reruns, malformed commands, protected-ref movement, under-scoped maintenance, non-main targets, reopened parallel work, and future control-plane guard changes without restoring one-time write authority.
This repository-governance cleanup performs no provider or runtime canary.
This cleanup performs no Production ref update, deployment, restart, SQL, Migration Apply, database mutation, provider action, or external business send.
